visual_dna.theme: The hand that deals the cards (reference styles E, editorial poster, and D, clean paper with window light, in the Dragon Psychology palette)
visual_dna.typography: Bebas Neue in giant capitals, partly behind the subject; Fraunces Black for the punch word and the big numbers; DM Mono for typed cards and labels; Permanent Marker for the investigator's notes. Kinetic system: slams that settle, drops with overshoot, lines typed key by key, marker loops and arrows that draw on, rubber stamps inked twice
visual_dna.surface: pale lab-paper studio sweep with a real crumpled-paper texture and window-blind shadows drifting over it; the room goes dark (slate) for the test and the lights come back on at the reveal; real black-and-white halftone photos and line engravings cut out with a white sticker edge and a hard offset shadow; cobalt discs, blocks and dashed rings behind the subject; torn white paper under headlines on photographs
visual_dna.palette: slate #141824, lab-paper #F0F4F8, cobalt #2B6CB0, amber #ED8936 (the one signal); film accent sign red #C53030 on the road sign, the parked car and red ink only
visual_dna.camera: moving on every shot: slow pushes and drifts, a close-up on the card, a follow then a push on the road clip, a push to the third card at the reveal. Pieces arrive one per beat and then jitter at 12 fps like stop-motion paper; the camera itself stays smooth
visual_dna.motif: an engraved hand deals index cards: one into an engraved head (the planted memory), fifteen held up one word each, three raised for the test. The thin amber 60-second bar stays
visual_dna.differs_from: look 1 of this film (see visual_dna_v1) and film 3's looks (a lab-paper grid with clocks and a stick-figure house plan; a white sheet on dotted slate set in Anton and Caveat)
visual_dna.status: shown to the owner on 2026-11-20 as 27 stills and a 21 s moving sample; the full 1:59 is not rendered until the owner says go

visual_dna_v1.theme: The evidence desk (archetype C, declassified archive, as a hybrid in the Dragon Psychology palette)
visual_dna_v1.typography: Archivo Black headlines; DM Mono for typewriter text and labels; Instrument Serif italic for quotes; Shadows Into Light for pencil notes. Kinetic system: stamp thuds, label-maker tape, typed strips, card flips; five paper treatments cycle through the word list
visual_dna_v1.surface: a slate cutting mat with a faint cobalt grid and a ruler edge; rigid paper with hard offset shadows; index cards, carbon-copy forms, exhibit tags
visual_dna_v1.palette: slate #141824, lab-paper #F0F4F8, cobalt #2B6CB0, amber #ED8936 (the one signal); film accent sign red #C53030 on road signs, the parked car and red ink only
visual_dna_v1.camera: overhead rostrum; hard cuts and whip-pans along the desk; stamps and typing stepped at 12 fps; slow pushes only on real photos
visual_dna_v1.motif: the intake stamp (RECEIVED, FILED, CERTAIN) and exhibit tags; the thin amber 60-second bar
visual_dna_v1.differs_from: film 3's looks: the lab-paper grid with clocks and a stick-figure house plan, then a white sheet on dotted slate set in Anton and Caveat
visual_dna_v1.retired: 2026-11-20: the owner saw the opening test in this look and was not happy with the look. It was graphics, not collage: drawn cards on a dark desk, about 10% real material, frames that did not build, a camera that barely moved
